title: Communication — Final Assessment
subject: Communication
description: Grade 2 end-of-year writing final: sentences, an invitation, a paragraph, and a friendly letter.

sections.name: Make a Sentence
sections.instruction: Put the mixed-up words in the right order to make a correct sentence. Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

questions.prompt: Put these words in order to make a sentence: dog / the / ran / fast
questions.hint: Which word tells who the sentence is about? Begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

questions.prompt: Put these words in order to make a sentence: like / I / apples / red
questions.hint: Start with the word 'I'. The colour word comes before what you like.

questions.prompt: Put these words in order to make a sentence: is / my / happy / friend
questions.hint: Who is happy? Begin with 'My friend'.

questions.prompt: Put these words in order to make a sentence: to / we / school / go
questions.hint: Start with 'We'. What do we do? Where do we go?

sections.name: Tell a Story in Order
sections.instruction: Write your story so the events happen in the right order. Use words like first, next, then and last.

questions.prompt: Tell the story of how you get ready for school in the morning. What do you do first, next, and last?
questions.hint: Use order words like 'First', 'Next', 'Then' and 'Last'. Write at least three sentences that happen in the right order, for example: First I wake up. Next I brush my teeth. Last I put on my uniform.

questions.prompt: Think about baking or making a snack you like. Write what happens first, next, and last.
questions.hint: Begin with 'First...', then 'Next...', then 'Last...'. Each step should follow the one before it so the story makes sense.

sections.name: Write an Invitation
sections.instruction: Write an invitation. Remember to tell WHAT the event is, WHEN it is, and WHERE it will be.

questions.prompt: Write an invitation to a friend to come to your birthday party.
questions.hint: A good invitation says WHAT (a birthday party), WHEN (the day and time), and WHERE (your house or another place). For example: 'You are invited to my birthday party on Saturday at 2 o'clock at my house.'

questions.prompt: Write an invitation asking a friend to come and play at your home after school.
questions.hint: Tell your friend WHAT you will do, WHEN to come, and WHERE to meet you. Start with 'Dear ___,' and sign your name at the end.

sections.name: Write a Paragraph
sections.instruction: Write 3 to 4 sentences about the topic. Each sentence should start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

questions.prompt: Write a paragraph of 3 to 4 sentences about your favourite animal. Tell what it looks like, what it eats, and why you like it.
questions.hint: Start with a sentence that names your favourite animal. Then add sentences about how it looks, what it eats, and why you like it. Use capital letters and full stops.

questions.prompt: Write a paragraph of 3 to 4 sentences about a day at the beach. What did you see, hear, and do?
questions.hint: Write 3 to 4 sentences that go together. Tell what you saw (the sea, sand), what you heard (the waves), and what you did (swim, build sandcastles).

questions.prompt: Write a paragraph of 3 to 4 sentences about your family. Who is in your family and what do you like to do together?
questions.hint: Begin by telling who is in your family. Then write about things you do together. End with a sentence that tells how you feel about your family.

sections.name: Write a Friendly Letter
sections.instruction: Write a short friendly letter. Remember the greeting, the body, and the closing.

questions.prompt: Write a short friendly letter to a friend telling them about something fun you did on the weekend.
questions.hint: Start with 'Dear ___,' on the first line. In the middle (the body) write 2 or 3 sentences about your weekend. End with a closing like 'Your friend, ___' and write your name.

questions.prompt: Write a short friendly letter to your grandma or grandpa to say hello and tell them how you are.
questions.hint: Begin with 'Dear Grandma,' or 'Dear Grandpa,'. Write a few sentences to say hello and share your news. Finish with 'Love, ___' and sign your name.

questions.prompt: Write a short friendly letter to a friend to thank them for a gift they gave you.
questions.hint: Start with the greeting 'Dear ___,'. In the body, thank your friend and say what you like about the gift. End with a closing such as 'Your friend, ___' and your name.
